rows.retained_qualification_summary: The short-variant category explicitly includes start-codon missense changes and short deletions spanning from upstream across the start codon, annotated M1?. Homozygous deletion involves at least one exon on both alleles irrespective of transcript. Rearrangements must disrupt protein function irrespective of transcript; the source describes intragenic partial-gene duplications, deletions and inversions, and events joining a PTEN breakpoint to another gene or intergenic sequence.
rows.projection_adjudication: The start-codon inclusions and rearrangement examples remain subordinate to the source classes. They are not separate output classes. Copy Number Alteration is a broad parent heading; homozygous deletion is the specific eligible class requested by r02. M1? is an open-ended annotation, not an individually specified amino-acid replacement.
rows.independent_support_limit: d0021 independently confirms the Table 9 projection. The physician intended-use table says PTEN alterations without supplying this complete definition; its analytical examples are not an exhaustive eligibility list.

ITD positivity is the companion criterion; TKD detection alone is insufficient, without implying that an ITD-positive patient must lack every TKD co-alteration.
